title: Release-candidate rehearsal, staged pilots and ecosystem rehearsal
claim_boundary: The release candidate and pilot programme are prepared, not executed or accepted. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

open_gates: Generate a committed lockfile and execute the complete compiler, test, security, reproducibility and attestation matrix.
Complete local, institutional self-hosted and remote single-tenant pilot exit decisions with rollback rehearsals.
Validate exact release candidate packets and obtain explicit approval before any release or registry submission.
assertions.permitted_claim: Scaffolding exists; behaviour is not claimed.
